voiceScript: That airport USB port carries data as well as power. Public USB Charging Stations means USB can carry both power and data; a tampered port could attempt a data connection, although confirmed juice-jacking attacks are uncommon. Picture this: an airport traveler plugs an unlocked phone into an unfamiliar public USB port. Here is why that matters: an untrusted data connection creates avoidable risk without making every charging station a crisis. Use your own wall charger or power bank.
